A layout-table row keeps an image as Markdown instead of degrading it to alt text

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td><img src=\"a.svg\" alt=\"A\"> <a href=\"/1\">x</a></td><td><a href=\"/2\">y</a></td></tr><tr><td><a href=\"/3\">z</a></td></tr></table>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
